applicabilityBasis.summary: Current VersaBank and Fiserv launch disclosures describe Roughrider as a live U.S.-dollar-backed stablecoin for bank-to-bank payments, issued by VersaBank USA National Association. BND describes 1:1 dollar backing with fiat-funded minting and automatic redemption/burning. BND also uses token-deposit language, but its FAQ uses that label for Tether/Circle and distinguishes actual tokenized bank deposits; no exact-token legal deposit liability establishing the statutory deposit exclusion was found. Apparent-payment-stablecoin is retained, with that legal-classification caveat.

genius.notes: IssuerEntity is corrected from Bank of North Dakota / Fiserv to VersaBank USA National Association, the exact bank issuer identified by current BND architecture and corroborated by VersaBank/Fiserv launch disclosures, consistent with the separate USDVB sibling issuer string. BND supplies program governance; Fiserv supplies platform/integration; neither is the final token issuer. Primary sources say Roughrider is already live (October 1 VersaBank/Fiserv announcements and October 5 BND confirmation), although the supplied research roster/base lifecycle remains pre-launch; no lifecycle metadata is edited here. Apparent-payment-stablecoin/issuer-announced-intent is retained because the product is explicitly marketed as a dollar-backed interbank payment stablecoin and BND says its program follows the GENIUS framework. The BND token-deposit terminology is not by itself evidence of a holder deposit liability: the same FAQ labels Tether/Circle token deposits and separates true tokenized deposits. VersaBank USDVB is a different legal deposit-token pilot and its exclusion must not be copied here. No qualifying token/issuer-specific GENIUS approval or pending application was located; an existing OCC bank charter and 2024 conditional business-line/name-change decision are not PPSI approval. No final GENIUS pathway is identified in the public sources; direct issuance by this bank must not be silently recast as an approved IDI-subsidiary route. Public reserve disclosure is descriptive only: one-to-one dollar backing through participating-institution FBO VersaBank custody accounts and an FBO concentration account at BND. Public mint/burn and redemption mechanics exist, but no separate token-specific monthly independent reserve examination was located. Broad promises of attestations do not count as a published monthly attestation. RedemptionPolicyPresent records the disclosed automated institutional cash/mint/burn mechanism, not guaranteed retail-holder access or separately reviewed contractual redemption terms. No relevant public issuer action was located in the consulted regulator materials and targeted search; this is not a supervisory no-action assurance.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No qualifying public GENIUS PPSI approval or pending application naming Roughrider/VersaBank USA was located in the consulted regulator sources and exact-issuer searches. Existing OCC charter/business-line permission does not establish such authorization. Current issuer/program materials state GENIUS-framework intent but do not identify a final PPSI route. No relevant public token/issuer enforcement action or published monthly token-specific independent reserve examination was found in the consulted materials. These are source-limited negative findings, not proof that no private filing, supervisory communication or unpublished attestation exists.
